name: Price level and conversion indices
review_status: The price-level field is derived from a published GESN base, which carries it once at document level (PriceLevel, 01.01.2022) and never per line. The index publication arrangements are drawn from public sources and are pending review by a Russian cost engineer.
description: A rouble figure in a Russian estimate is meaningless without the date it is a rouble of. The norm base is published at a base price level and the current cost is reached by applying a conversion index for the region, the quarter and the kind of work. Two estimates that differ by a factor of five may be the same estimate at two price levels, and the only thing that distinguishes an out-of-date number from a wrong one is whether the document says which level it is in.

document_level_fields.note: A date, not a year. The published base carries it as a single document attribute, so an estimate that states it once has stated it for every line.
Region, quarter and work type. An index applied to the wrong quarter is arithmetically invisible: the sum is still a number and nothing about it looks wrong.
Which price book or state price system the current prices came from, so a reviewer can reach the same figure.

index_application.к СМР: One index to the whole construction and installation cost, the coarse form.
index_application.по элементам затрат: Separate indices to labour, plant and material, which is what the resource-index method assumes and what a reviewer expects on a state contract.
index_application.note: The two produce different totals from the same resources, so which one was used belongs in the document rather than in the estimator's head.
